source_evidence.quote: However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored.
We fit accuracy linearly against $\log _ { 2 }$ of the decoding FLOPs per response (Appendix A.4.2).

checks.assessment: 核对初稿对研究缺口与因果的转述：原文明确说的是参数共享带来额外深度、代价为每次迭代的解码成本，且既有研究在匹配参数量或每 token FLOPs 下的比较无法回答「输出 token 预算增加时 looping 是否改善 accuracy–compute 缩放」。初稿这两点表述与原文一致，未发现夸大；但初稿未点出「本文的判别量是 accuracy–compute scaling slope 随 output-token 预算变化」这一限定，已在批注中补明。本段无数字、无公式，故不存在公式解释越界问题；初稿提到的两类计算路径（token 空间长 CoT / latent 空间循环）与原文一一对应，予以保留。
checks.source_quote: Parameter sharing makes additional depth possible without increasing model size, but each iteration still incurs decoding cost. Prior scaling studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameter counts or per-token FLOPs (Prairie et al., 2026; Schwethelm et al., 2026b; Wang et al., 2026b). These comparisons do not establish whether looping improves accuracy– compute scaling as output-token budgets increase.

checks.assessment: 对数字、因果与方法条件逐项核对并作出修正：(1) 数字核对——初稿完全遗漏 2.12/2.27/2.26 与 1.79、M = 2/M = 3、output-token cutoff 至 16K、斜率定义为「解码 FLOPs 每翻一倍的准确率增量」，已补入。(2) 术语修正——初稿称 Huginn 为「混合架构」，原文为 middle-block recurrence，属事实性错误，已改正。(3) 因果方向修正——初稿写「在低预算下表现不佳，但在高预算下展现出更陡峭的缩放斜率」，原文是「斜率更陡，但在重叠计算区间内仍更不准确」，初稿隐含的「高预算下反超」无原文支持，已改为原文的斜率与精度双条件表述。(4) 越界推断标记——初稿的「超线性缩放能力」与「优势依赖于足够的推理步数来积累信息」均为原文未作的断言或机制解释，已明确标注为推断/待证。(5) 图表界限——Figure 1a 未提供图像视觉信息，批注仅依据正文文字描述，未对曲线形状作额外声称。
checks.source_quote: In this post-training setting, fixed-depth and adaptive Ouro (maximum iteration depth M = 2) and Huginn (M = 3) yield steeper scaling slopes than Standard (2.12, 2.27 and 2.26 versus 1.79), yet remain less accurate over the overlapping compute range (Figure 1a).

checks.assessment: 核对方法主张：初稿称「联合后训练 + 在线前瞻监督」与「成本敏感损失」均被原文支持（depth labels are derived online from changes in prediction loss；a cost-sensitive loss supervises each depth decision）。保留。修正两点：(1) 动机表述补上原文的「many tokens gain little or even get worse」，因为原文并非只说「低收益」，也包括「变差」；(2) 删除或标注对 TaH2 缩写的猜测（该猜测出现在 block 5 批注）。updater 与 stopping probabilities 的对应引用（Geiping et al., 2025a；Zeng et al., 2026）与原文一致。TaH 对比部分原文明确限定为监督信号来源差异（offline mismatch labels vs. 当前 backbone 实测增益），批注未越界。
checks.source_quote: We introduce TaH2 to improve test-time scaling by learning which tokens benefit from additional iterations and allocating depth accordingly.

checks.assessment: 逐数字核对：53%、2.74 vs. 1.79、1.7B、AIME24–26 均与原文一致，且度量口径为「每解码 FLOPs 翻倍的点数」，初稿未标出口径，已补充。修正：「约 3.4 点」在原文附有条件「With evaluation extended to 32K tokens」和「at matched decoding FLOPs」，比较对象是 Standard 的 peak accuracy（Figure 4b），初稿省略了 32K 条件，已在批注中补回。修正：+2.8→+3.9 的增益在原文中明确是 over the non-looped baseline，初稿表述可能被误读为相对其他 looped 模型，已明确比较基准。泛化范围（4B/8B、code/QA/tool use，Table 3）与原文一致。
checks.source_quote: On AIME24–26 at 1.7B, TaH2 improves the accuracy– compute slope by 53% over the non-looped baseline (2.74 vs. 1.79 points per doubling of decoding FLOPs).

checks.assessment: 该段为纯引导句，无技术主张。初稿批注「后续应列出具体技术或理论贡献」中「应」带有预测语气，但后文 block 4–6 确实为三条贡献列表，故不构成错误；仅将措辞改为事实性描述（其后三条贡献分别对应什么），不新增主张。
checks.source_quote: We summarise our contributions as follows.

checks.assessment: 核对因果与条件：原文同时陈述「looped 模型斜率更陡」与「matched test-time compute 下不如 Standard」，初稿准确。修正：初稿追加的「单纯更多迭代不等于更高效，故需要智能停止机制」属原文未明写的因果推断，已显式标注为推断，并指向 Section 3.2 / Figure 1、4 需回正文验证，避免把推断当作原文结论。
checks.source_quote: We study how looping changes accuracy–compute scaling and find that, although post-trained looped models often yield steeper slopes, they underperform Standard at matched test-time compute.

checks.assessment: 方法条件核对：jointly post-trains backbone + iteration decider、online labels 的语义（further iteration improves prediction）与原文一致，保留。修正：初稿将 TaH2 展开为「Test-time Adaptive Heuristic/Hub?」属无原文依据的猜测（本节及源块均未定义缩写），已删除并标注为待证。初稿「实现了动态的深度控制」为对方法效果的合理概括，保留但不再扩展为实验结论。
checks.source_quote: We propose TaH2, which jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider, directly supervising depth decisions with online labels indicating whether further iteration improves prediction.

checks.assessment: 数字一致性核对：+2.8→+3.9（深度 2→8，over Standard）与约 3.4 点均与原文一致，且这两组数字与 block 2 内部自洽（比较对象均为 Standard）。修正/标注：「about 3.4」保留「约」字，不得当作精确值；原文条件「when Standard plateaus」与 block 2 的「32K tokens」需合读，批注已提示两处口径差异。初稿未逐字核对 AIME 基准名称与「challenging」限定，已确认与原文一致。
checks.source_quote: On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 yields a steeper accuracy–compute slope than Standard and achieves about 3.4 points higher accuracy at matched compute when Standard plateaus.

checks.assessment: 核对本文研究问题与实验条件的表述。原文逐字支持三点：研究对象是 looping 对 accuracy–compute scaling 的影响、自变量是 output budget 增大、比较对象是 post-trained looped 与 non-looped 且 matched decoding FLOPs。初稿"严格匹配 decoding FLOPs"与"聚焦循环结构在解码预算增加时的缩放规律"均可由原文支撑，予以保留。但对 matched decoding FLOPs 的动机解释（"为公平比较、排除 token 数优势"）原文未写，已改为推断并标注待证。另核对初稿对 token-based/latent-space 两路径的分类，与原文列举（CoT、budget forcing/RL、repeated sampling、tree search、latent optimization、looped transformers）一致。
checks.source_quote: We study how looping changes accuracy–compute scaling as output budgets increase, comparing post-trained looped and non-looped models at matched decoding FLOPs (Section 3).

checks.assessment: 核对循环架构归类与缩放研究匹配设定。初稿"Huginn（中间块）、Ouro（全栈）、Loopies（单层）"与原文逐一对应，正确。但初稿将缩放研究概括为"参数匹配 vs FLOPs 匹配"两档，遗漏原文的第三档"or both, as in SMELT"，已补出。核对 TaH2 定位句 "TaH2 builds on this post-training setting to learn token-dependent iteration depths"，初稿"学习 token-dependent iteration depths"正确；"从预训练非循环模型出发引入循环能力"是对 post-training setting 的解释性展开，原文此段未逐字展开，已标注为解释性表述；"为后续埋下伏笔"属结构观察，已标注非原文陈述。
checks.source_quote: Recent scaling studies examine recurrence under matched parameter counts (Prairie et al., 2026), matched per-token FLOPs (Schwethelm et al., 2026b), or both, as in SMELT (Wang et al., 2026b).

checks.assessment: 核对自适应计算分类与 TaH2 定位。width/depth 分类、MoR 容量约束 router、pondering 类损失+预算/置信度惩罚、Kuo 的 terminal reward、TaH 的 offline mismatch labels + separate stages、Ouro 的冻结 backbone + token-level loss improvements 监督 gate，均与原文一致。关键修正：初稿未写出 TaH2 标签的 online 来源与 "measured iteration gains along decider-selected routes"，这是与 TaH offline labels 的核心对照，已补出。同时 "端到端联合优化"、"允许主干适应新的循环逻辑" 原文未使用相应措辞，已标注为推断而非原文陈述。另补充原文末句关于 Appendix E（scaling、state design、serving）的说明。
checks.source_quote: TaH2 jointly post-trains the backbone and decider through lookahead depth supervision, deriving online token-level labels from measured iteration gains along decider-selected routes.

checks.assessment: 核对本节目标：原文是「形式化递归计算 + 实证展示已有循环模型的测试时扩展行为」，批注据此表述一致；删除了初稿中「揭示现有循环 Transformer 的局限」这一超出本节开头声明的措辞，因为「局限」是后文结果的产物而非本句的承诺。
checks.source_quote: We formalise the recurrent computation of looped transformers and empirically show the test-time scaling behavior of existing looped transformers.

checks.assessment: 逐项核对符号定义：下标为 token 位置、上标为迭代轮次、$\mathcal{F}_\theta$ 为共享 Transformer 骨干、$\mathbf{e}_t$ 为 token $t$ 的嵌入、$\mathbf{h}_t^{(m)}$ 为第 $m$ 轮后的隐藏状态，以及起点 $\mathbf{h}_t^{(0)}=\mathbf{e}_t$，均与原文一致。修正了初稿「共享权重 $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ 的骨干网络 $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ 被反复应用」这一主语重复且有歧义的错误表述。
checks.source_quote: We focus on models that repeat all L Transformer layers, denoting the shared Transformer backbone by $\mathcal { F } _ { \theta }$ and the embedding at token position t by $\mathbf { e } _ { t }$ . Let $\mathbf { h } _ { t } ^ { ( m ) }$ denote the hidden state at token position t after iteration m.

checks.assessment: 核对 Eq. (1) 的两段含义：上行用共享骨干 $\mathcal{F}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}$ 作用在上一轮隐藏状态上完成递归更新，下行用 $\mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{out}}$ 投影后经 softmax 得到 next-token 分布。修正初稿「$\boldsymbol{\theta}$ 表示参数矩阵」的错误——原文中 $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ 是骨干网络参数，输出投影是 $\mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{out}}$；同时删除初稿中关于 GitHub MathJax 渲染（\tag、\mathrm）的排版性内容，改为批读该公式在本文机制中的作用。

核对三类模型设定及其深度记号：Ouro 沿用 Eq. (1) 的递归、Huginn 只重复中间 block 并做 input injection、$m_t\in\{1,\ldots,M\}$ 为 token $t$ 的实际执行深度、Fixed-depth 取 $m_t=M$、Standard 取 $m_t=1$、Adaptive 逐 token 选 $m_t$（Ouro 用学习到的 exit gate），均与原文一致，未发现数字或条件错误。批注另补充了「Standard 深度 1 与循环模型最大深度 $M$ 的算力口径需按 FLOPs 对齐」这一注解式提醒，未改变原文主张。
checks.source_quote: Here $\mathbf { W _ { \mathrm { o u t } } }$ is the output projection. Ouro follows this recurrence (Zhu et al., 2025). Huginn repeats only a middle block, with input injection at each iteration (Geiping et al., 2025a).

checks.assessment: 核对实验设置的数字与条件：基座 Qwen3-1.7B-Base、同一数据、16K 上下文、Ouro $M=2$、Huginn $M=3$、Huginn 固定深度、Ouro 在固定深度与 exit gate 两种方式下评估且 gate 在冻结骨干上事后训练（Appendix A.2）；AIME24–26 平均准确率、每题 32 样本、输出 cutoff 4K–16K 以 2K 递增、对每条响应解码 FLOPs 的 $\log_2$ 做线性拟合（Appendix A.4.2），均与原文吻合。批注额外点明「斜率是拟合估计量而非定律」，属方法论边界说明而非新增事实。

checks.source_quote: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional inference compute (Jaech et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2025; Snell et al., 2024). checks.source_quote: Fixed-depth iteration spends extra compute on every token, although many tokens gain little or even get worse (Section 3.2). Ouro’s adaptive exit gate improves compute efficiency, but not enough to surpass Standard. We introduce TaH2 to improve test-time scaling by learning which tokens benefit from additional iterations and allocating depth accordingly. The backbone and an iteration decider are jointly post-trained through lookahead depth supervision: depth labels are derived online from changes in prediction loss, and a cost-sensitive loss supervises each depth decision (Figure 2). Unlike TaH’s staged training with offline mismatch labels (Fu et al., 2025b), TaH2 supervises depth decisions using actual iteration gains measured on the current backbone throughout training. In addition, an updater provides input injection between iterations (Geiping et al., 2025a), and stopping probabilities weight the predictions across executed depths (Zeng et al., 2026).
